features.title: Native macOS shell, phase 1: headless engine + Swift dictation
features.user_visible_behavior: SwiftUI menu-bar Parley.app dictates end to end (gesture, speak, release, pasted) with a glass HUD, driving the TypeScript engine under bundled Node over stdio JSON-RPC.
features.plan: none: native shell, no web surface. Spec: docs/plans/parley-019-native-shell.md
verification: Live: dictate into TextEdit, Notes, Slack from Parley.app; latency and RSS vs Electron
evidence: 2026-11-05 unit: headless-rpc 12 + headless-engine 14 vitest pass; ParleyCore 23 swift tests pass; tsc + eslint clean
2026-11-05 build: make -C macos build clean (0 warnings), signed Apple Development; engine.mjs 40K + node v24.22.1 117M in Resources
2026-11-05 smoke: bundled engine answers hello over stdio, refuses protocol 7; app refuses to start engine while Electron Parley runs
2026-11-05 baseline: Electron Parley 276 MB RSS over 9 processes, 541 MB on disk

2026-11-05 live: Parley Native.app, Electron quit; hello ok (engine 0.6.4); Accessibility granted live, key tap started without relaunch; 3 dictations via Left Shift x2 hold: listening -> transcribing -> pasted 14/29/23 chars -> done. Gesture release to paste 1.4 s, 1.1 s, 0.9 s (Groq via parley-api over Tailscale).
2026-11-05 Accessibility and Microphone survive a rebuild and relaunch (Apple Development signing).
2026-11-05 memory after use: app 196 MB + engine 102 MB RSS (idle before first use: 75 + 51). Not yet compared like for like with Electron (276 MB idle).

features.title: Native settings window: general, keys, provider, dictionary, onboarding
features.user_visible_behavior: A Liquid Glass settings window (design: claude.ai/artifact/Mirpic2JxR1ZZyewgN8nZL) edits settings and the personal dictionary through the engine, and a first-run flow asks for Microphone and Accessibility.
verification: Live: change gesture key and provider, add a dictionary word, both take effect on the next dictation

features.title: Native voice edit, including terminals and long documents
features.user_visible_behavior: Voice edit on its own gesture rewrites the selection or focused field (terminal input after the prompt, the caret's paragraph in long documents) from the native shell, with Accessibility read in-process.
verification: Live: voice edit in TextEdit, Notes and iTerm2

features.title: Native Explain popover
features.user_visible_behavior: Explain on its own gesture answers a question about the selection in a glass popover anchored to it, streamed from parley-api.
verification: Live: explain a selection in Safari and TextEdit

features.title: Native Act mode with the Mastra agent
features.user_visible_behavior: Act on its own gesture hands the command to the bundled parley-agent, with progress and approvals on the pill.
verification: Live: an Act command that needs one approval

features.title: Native sync, token in the Keychain
features.user_visible_behavior: Sync of dictionary and settings works from the native shell, the token stored in the Keychain by Swift and handed to the engine.
verification: Live: a word added on Android appears on the Mac
